summary: General Catalyst Global Resilience Merger Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its S-1 registration statement and the consummation of its initial public offering on May 1, 2026. The SPAC issued 40,250,000 units (including full over-allotment) at $10.00 per unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one-fourth of a redeemable warrant ($11.50 exercise price), for gross proceeds of $402.5 million. The sponsor purchased 905,000 private placement units. The underwriter is Citigroup. As a newly formed blank-check company, the registrant will seek a business combination target. Watch for the target announcement and shareholder vote.
